title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report gives compressible equations; numerics.cpp:238–241 omits the density-gradient term when forming velocity gradients from conservative variables, so its transverse viscous gradients need not match report.tex:363–365.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads TRI_3 and QUAD_4 sections and merges zone vertices, but :250–254 rejects other volume section types including CGNS MIXED. Coordinate hashing and arbitrary zone joins were not independently validated.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:62–87 assembles signed interior fluxes, but numerics.cpp:5–62 leaves ghost gradients zero, so partition-side reconstructed states and independently assembled fluxes can differ across ranks.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Production solver.cpp:70 calls Rusanov; report discloses that dissipative choice. Roe source exists but is not the production flux; shock accuracy is not independently established.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:91–125 dispatches farfield, slip and adiabatic wall fluxes; submitted wall output passes validator. General boundary accuracy was not independently tested.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares and Barth reconstruction are present, but ghost gradients are identically zero at partition faces and no grid-refinement verification was located; claimed second order is not uniform across ranks.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: numerics.cpp:64–113 computes Barth-Jespersen limiting for owned cells in production. Ghost-side slope is zero; positivity falls back at inadmissible reconstructed states.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: numerics.cpp:238–260 omits density terms in primitive velocity gradients before directional correction; solver.cpp:214–225 integrates full viscous traction but report.tex:1006–1009 calls it skin friction. Output.cpp:196–199 computes tangential Cf separately.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady local pseudo-time and LU-SGS paths exist in solver.cpp; rank-sensitive ghost reconstruction and early residual-based termination limit confidence in converged forces.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:555–608 assembles BDF physical residual with frozen states and checks actual inner ratios; Re200 records one target miss and t=300. It assigns statistically_periodic unconditionally at :656, though this result has visible lift cycles.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: mesh.cpp:417 invokes METIS and solver.cpp:14–38 exchanges state, but a replicated full GlobalMesh remains alive on every rank and ghost gradients are not exchanged. Observed np4/8 Re20 Cd differs 4.3%.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
